summary.text: Rachel Fetty Anderson, a Democratic public interest attorney, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. Senate in West Virginia to Shelley Moore Capito.
She won the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary over former state Senate President Jeff Kessler and others and has served two terms on the Morgantown City Council.

paragraphs.text: Anderson was homeschooled and earned a GED, then received a bachelor's degree from Iowa State University in 1996 and a law degree from the University of Iowa in 1999.

She works as a public interest attorney and advocate, a career the Associated Press puts at three decades, and says she has represented children, families and individuals and has seen the foster care system from both sides.
Anderson served two terms on the Morgantown City Council.
She describes herself as a mother of four whose family has lived in West Virginia since 2007.
In the Democratic primary she defeated Jeff Kessler, Zachary Shrewsbury, Thornton Cooper and Rio Phillips, according to the Associated Press.
During the campaign, her campaign website listed health care, children and families, and human rights among her priorities.
She received 37.9% of the vote to Shelley Moore Capito's 58.3%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: Anderson wins Democratic nomination in US Senate race
